_comment: Refining recipes. id: recipe id; inputs: {item name: count}; output: item name; stages: up to 4 {name, steps: [{name, description, action (action id), ap, tool (item that must be in the bags)}]} done in order (or one stage: stage + steps); max_ap: action points (default 100); xp: crafting experience; catalyst: {item, quality (added once, when the player adds it)}; complications: [{name, description, stage (index), chance, penalty (quality lost per action while active), counter: {action, family (unused by steps), name, description, ap, strength (health removed per use, of 100)}}]. Placeholder data (docs/CONTENT_EDITOR.md). category: recipe book group (1 General, 2 Unique, 3 Work Order); work_order: true keeps the recipe out of the book until the player takes a work order that uses it.
